messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- [2025-04-22] standup/cinder/2025-04-22: The search indexer is pinned to OpenSearch 2.11; the pin lifts when the full reindex completes.
- [2025-06-24] standup/dune/2025-06-24: Reporting still relies on Ledger; keep that in mind for the maintenance.
- [2025-12-05] handover/2025-12-05-reporting: From today the pager for reporting rings the Ember team, not the Dune team. Ownership transferred.
- [2026-04-13] standup/ember/2026-04-13-2: Ember still owns the reporting service, in case anyone asks.
- [2025-09-23] standup/dune/2025-09-23: Reporting switches from Ledger to the bus as its source. Why: the nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs. Reporting no longer depends on Ledger.
- [2026-04-14] standup/dune/2026-04-14-2: The Dune team noticed that the reporting service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners.
- [2025-04-15] standup/dune/2025-04-15: The reports pipeline must stay on Python 3.11 until the pandas 3 upgrade lands.
- [2025-12-25] standup/atlas/2025-12-25: Atlas saw that the reports pipeline's disk usage jumped 30 percent following the retention change; not their service, so they flagged it. Atlas has moved to the second floor.
- [2026-06-01] standup/ember/2026-06-01: For newcomers: the deploy window for the reporting service is still on Tuesdays and Thursdays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.
- [2025-03-20] standup/dune/2025-03-20: Reminder: the reports pipeline is owned by Dune.
- [2025-01-21] standup/dune/2025-01-21: Dependency map update: reporting needs the ledger service (the nightly balance export).
- [2025-01-20] standup/dune/2025-01-20-2: The reporting service is a the Dune team service.
- [2025-03-26] standup/dune/2025-03-26: Reminder that the reporting service only ships on Tuesdays and Thursdays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC. Observation from team Dune: after the cache change, the notification service's memory use grew steadily for a week.
- [2026-05-27] standup/atlas/2026-05-27: Decided in today's standup: the event-bus will retain messages for seven days, since replaying a full week has covered every incident recovery so far. The Atlas team noticed that search-indexer's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners. The catalog still relies on the resizer; keep that in mind for the maintenance.
- [2025-01-31] standup/atlas/2025-01-31: Ledger must stay on Postgres 14 until the partitioning work finishes.
- [2026-06-04] standup/boreal/2026-06-04: Boreal noticed that the catalog service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change and pinged the owners.
- [2025-04-29] standup/ember/2025-04-29: The scheduler still relies on the feature flag service; keep that in mind for the maintenance.
- [2025-02-21] standup/boreal/2025-02-21-2: Boreal noticed that the ledger service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change and pinged the owners.
- [2025-06-11] handover/2025-06-11-notifier: The notification service has a new home: Cinder. Boreal kept it until today.
- [2026-05-28] standup/ember/2026-05-28: Ember noticed that the ledger service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners.
- [2025-05-07] standup/boreal/2025-05-07-2: The Boreal team noticed that the authentication gateway's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump and pinged the owners.
- [2025-04-24] standup/cinder/2025-04-24-2: Heads-up from the Cinder team: feature-flags' p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy.
- [2025-03-28] standup/atlas/2025-03-28: Priya still has the Atlas pager.
- [2026-04-16] standup/atlas/2026-04-16: The Atlas team saw that the ledger service's disk usage jumped 30 percent following the retention change; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2025-12-31] standup/atlas/2025-12-31: Atlas saw that the feature flag service's queue depth hit 50,000 following the marketing send; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2026-04-08] standup/atlas/2026-04-08: Reminder from the Atlas team: page Marcus for anything this cycle, not Priya. The Atlas team saw that webhooks' request volume halved following the client rollout; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2026-04-01] handover/2026-04-01-search-indexer: From today the pager for the search indexer rings the Boreal team, not team Atlas. Ownership transferred.
- [2026-06-04] standup/atlas/2026-06-04: Priya Raman has the Atlas pager this cycle, taking over from Marcus.
- [2025-09-02] standup/atlas/2025-09-02: Decided in today's standup: clients will cache feature-flags evaluations for 30 seconds, since feature-flags saw 40,000 requests per second at peak and most of them were identical.
- [2026-03-11] standup/cinder/2026-03-11: No deploys to Ledger from 2026-03-30 to 2026-04-03 because of the fiscal year close.
